title: brand/ctas.yml
description: The call-to-action library. Every post ends with exactly one CTA, picked by key (e.g. 'cta: get-quote' in a calendar entry).

propertyNames.$comment: CTA keys are lowercase words joined by hyphens, e.g. get-quote, site-audit.

label.$comment: Short human name, used in previews and reports.

url.$comment: Clean link with NO tracking parameters; tracking is appended automatically when utm is true.

text.$comment: A ready-made closing line per platform. Deliberately different per platform: identical text is rejected by X and down-ranked by Meta.
